identity.seed_rule: first128bits SHA256(canonicalJSON([namespace,seed,dimensions,n_seq,length])) as four little-endian uint32 words
identity.source: Independent Dirichlet(1,...,1) rows in each coordinate; fresh uniform joint permutation; uniform initial symbol.
identity.stratum_rule: Median split of each coordinate mean row entropy divided by log2(coordinate dimension); equal-to-median is high. Membership is fixed from source matrices before scoring models.
identity.cumulative_rule: At time t sum realized losses predicting tokens2 through t+1.

uncertainty: One standard error across independent complete sequences; differences use paired per-sequence values. Seeds remain separate.
caveat: Conditional costs can be negative; posterior ignorance costs are nonnegative only in expectation over the full prior. Entropy bins are source-only descriptive strata; no model-outcome selection.
